Excellent detective work! **Face detection is 100% working** - it's detecting 1-4 faces per frame!

The issue is you're not seeing the **green boxes** on the Magic Leap display. Let me check a couple things:

**Question 1:** When you're wearing the Magic Leap, do you see the **camera feed itself** (the live video) on the display? Or do you see nothing at all?

If you see the live camera feed but NO green boxes, then the boxes are being drawn but might be:
- Too thin to see
- Wrong color
- Drawn in the wrong place

If you see **nothing at all**, then the RawImage isn't positioned correctly in your Unity scene.

Let me also make the green boxes MUCH more visible - thicker lines and bigger:

```csharp

using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using OpenCvSharp;
using OpenCvSharp.Unity;
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.IO;
using UnityEngine.Networking;

public class FaceDetector : MonoBehaviour
{
    // Unity will auto-load native libraries from Assets/Plugins/Android/libs/x86_64/
    
    public RawImage DisplayImage;
    public float DetectionBoxScale = 2.0f;
    public int DownsampleFactor = 2;  // Changed from 4 to 2 for better detection

    private WebCamTexture _webCamTexture;
    private CascadeClassifier _cascade;
    private Mat _rgbaMat;
    private Mat _grayMat;
    private Texture2D _displayTexture;
    private bool _isInitialized = false;

    private const string CameraPermission = "android.permission.CAMERA";

    void Start()
    {
        Debug.Log($"FaceDetector starting - DisplayImage assigned: {DisplayImage != null}");
        StartCoroutine(CheckAndRequestPermissions());
    }

    private IEnumerator CheckAndRequestPermissions()
    {
        Debug.Log("Checking for camera permission...");

        if (UnityEngine.Android.Permission.HasUserAuthorizedPermission(CameraPermission))
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission already granted.");
            yield return StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission not yet granted. Requesting...");
            var callbacks = new UnityEngine.Android.PermissionCallbacks();
            callbacks.PermissionGranted += OnPermissionGranted;
            callbacks.PermissionDenied += OnPermissionDenied;
            callbacks.PermissionDeniedAndDontAskAgain += OnPermissionDenied;
            UnityEngine.Android.Permission.RequestUserPermission(CameraPermission, callbacks);
        }
    }

    private void OnPermissionGranted(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.Log($"Permission {permissionName} was granted. Proceeding with initialization.");
        StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
    }

    private void OnPermissionDenied(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.LogError($"Permission {permissionName} was denied. Face detection cannot start.");
    }

    private IEnumerator InitializeEverything()
    {
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZING WEBCAM ===");
        
        // Add timeout protection
        float timeout = 30f; // 30 seconds timeout
        float startTime = Time.time;
        
        // Get available cameras
        WebCamDevice[] devices = WebCamTexture.devices;
        Debug.Log($"Found {devices.Length} camera devices");
        
        if (devices.Length == 0)
        {
            Debug.LogError("ERROR: No cameras found on device!");
            yield break;
        }

        // Log available cameras
        for (int i = 0; i < devices.Length; i++)
        {
            Debug.Log($"Camera {i}: {devices[i].name} (Front: {devices[i].isFrontFacing})");
        }

        // Try Camera 2 instead - Camera 0 was completely black (tracking sensor, not RGB camera)
        // Magic Leap 2 has: 2 tracking sensors + 1 RGB camera on top
        int cameraIndex = 2;  // Try camera 2 (top RGB camera)
        Debug.Log($"🎥 Attempting to use Camera {cameraIndex}: {devices[cameraIndex].name}");
        _webCamTexture = new WebCamTexture(devices[cameraIndex].name, 1280, 720, 30);
        _webCamTexture.Play();

        Debug.Log($"Started camera: {devices[cameraIndex].name}, waiting for first frame...");
        int waitFrames = 0;
        while (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            waitFrames++;
            if (waitFrames > 300) // 10 seconds at 30fps
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Camera timeout! Camera playing: {_webCamTexture.isPlaying}, Size: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height}");
                yield break;
            }
            yield return null;
        }

        Debug.Log($"=== CAMERA STARTED: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height} @ {_webCamTexture.requestedFPS}fps ===");

        Debug.Log("OpenCV libraries should be auto-loaded by Unity from Plugins folder...");
        
        // Check timeout
        if (Time.time - startTime > timeout)
        {
            Debug.LogError("TIMEOUT: Initialization took too long!");
            yield break;
        }
        
        // Add a small delay to let Unity load the libraries
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
        
        try
        {
            Debug.Log("Testing OpenCV initialization...");
            // Try a simple OpenCV operation to test if libraries loaded
            using (var testMat = new Mat(1, 1, MatType.CV_8UC1))
            {
                Debug.Log($"OpenCV test Mat created successfully! Size: {testMat.Width}x{testMat.Height}");
            }
            Debug.Log("OpenCV library loaded successfully!");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR: OpenCV failed to initialize! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
            yield break;
        }
        
        Debug.Log("Loading Haar Cascade classifier...");
        string cascadePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
        
        using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(cascadePath))
        {
            yield return www.SendWebRequest();
            if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Failed to load haarcascade file: {www.error}");
                yield break;
            }
            
            string tempPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
            File.WriteAllBytes(tempPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
            Debug.Log($"Wrote cascade to: {tempPath}");
            
            try
            {
                Debug.Log($"Creating CascadeClassifier from: {tempPath}");
                _cascade = new CascadeClassifier(tempPath);
                Debug.Log("CascadeClassifier object created");
                
                if (_cascade.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogError("ERROR: Cascade classifier is empty!");
                    yield break;
                }
                Debug.Log("Cascade classifier loaded successfully!");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR creating CascadeClassifier! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
                Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
                if (ex.InnerException != null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"Inner exception: {ex.InnerException.GetType().Name}: {ex.InnerException.Message}");
                }
                yield break;
            }
        }

        Debug.Log($"Creating Mats and display texture ({_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height})...");
        _grayMat = new Mat(_webCamTexture.height, _webCamTexture.width, MatType.CV_8UC1);
        _displayTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false);
        
        if (DisplayImage != null)
        {
            DisplayImage.texture = _displayTexture;
            Debug.Log($"✅ Display texture assigned to RawImage - you'll see the camera feed with face boxes!");
            Debug.Log($"RawImage size: {DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.width}x{DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.height}");
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ WARNING: No RawImage found for display. Face detection is running but won't be visible.");
        }

        _isInitialized = true;
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZATION COMPLETE! Face detection should now be running. ===");
    }

    private int _frameCount = 0;
    private int _totalFacesDetected = 0;
    private bool _savedDebugFrames = false;
    
    void Update()
    {
        if (!_isInitialized || _webCamTexture == null || !_webCamTexture.isPlaying)
        {
            // Log why we're not processing (only every 60 frames to avoid spam)
            if (Time.frameCount % 60 == 0)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"Not processing: _isInitialized={_isInitialized}, _webCamTexture={_webCamTexture != null}, isPlaying={_webCamTexture?.isPlaying}");
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            return;
        }

        _frameCount++;
        
        // Log that we're actually processing
        if (_frameCount == 1)
        {
            Debug.Log("🎬 FIRST FRAME PROCESSING STARTED!");
        }
        
        try
        {
            TextureToMat();
            
            // Debug logging for first few frames
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: GrayMat size {_grayMat.Width}x{_grayMat.Height}, channels={_grayMat.Channels()}");
            }
            
            // Save debug frames (first 3 frames only)
            if (!_savedDebugFrames && _frameCount <= 3)
            {
                SaveDebugFrame(_frameCount);
                if (_frameCount == 3)
                {
                    _savedDebugFrames = true;
                    Debug.Log("✅ Debug frames saved! Use 'adb pull' to retrieve them from device.");
                }
            }
            
            // Downsample for performance
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            
            // Apply histogram equalization to improve contrast - VERY important for face detection!
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: SmallMat size {smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} for detection (with histogram equalization)");
            }

            // MUCH more relaxed detection parameters to test
            OpenCvSharp.Rect[] faces = _cascade.DetectMultiScale(
                image: smallMat,
                scaleFactor: 1.05,      // Smaller scale factor = more sensitive
                minNeighbors: 2,        // Even fewer neighbors = more detections (was 3)
                flags: HaarDetectionTypes.ScaleImage,
                minSize: new Size(15, 15)  // Smaller minimum size (was 20x20)
            );

            // Log detection results more frequently at first
            if (_frameCount <= 10 || (_frameCount % 30 == 0))
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: Detected {faces.Length} faces");
            }

            if (faces.Length > 0)
            {
                _totalFacesDetected += faces.Length;
                Debug.Log($"🟢 FACE DETECTED! Frame {_frameCount}: {faces.Length} face(s) - Drawing green boxes now!");
            }

            foreach (var face in faces)
            {
                var scaledRect = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(
                    face.X * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Y * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Width * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Height * DownsampleFactor
                );
                
                // Draw THICK bright green rectangle - very visible!
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.LimeGreen, 10);  // Increased from 3 to 10
                // Also draw an inner rectangle for extra visibility
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.Yellow, 5);
            }

            MatToTexture();
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            // Log status every 5 seconds
            if (_frameCount % 150 == 0)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Status - Frame: {_frameCount}, Total faces found: {_totalFacesDetected}, Current faces: {faces.Length}");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"ERROR in Update: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    private void TextureToMat()
    {
        // Dispose the Mat from the previous frame to prevent a memory leak
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        
        // Convert WebCamTexture to Texture2D-compatible format
        Texture2D tempTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGB24, false);
        tempTexture.SetPixels32(_webCamTexture.GetPixels32());
        tempTexture.Apply();
        
        _rgbaMat = TextureConverter.TextureToMat(tempTexture);
        Destroy(tempTexture);
        
        Cv2.CvtColor(_rgbaMat, _grayMat, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
    }

    private void MatToTexture()
    {
        TextureConverter.MatToTexture(_rgbaMat, _displayTexture);
    }
    
    private void SaveDebugFrame(int frameNum)
    {
        try
        {
            // Use app's external files directory - no extra permissions needed!
            // This is at: /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.DefaultCompany.MagicLeap_Recogneyes/files/
            string saveDir = Application.persistentDataPath;
            
            Debug.Log($"💾 Saving debug frame {frameNum} to: {saveDir}");
            
            // Save original color frame
            string colorPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_original.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(colorPath, _rgbaMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved ORIGINAL (1280x720 color) → {colorPath}");
            
            // Save grayscale frame
            string grayPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_grayscale.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(grayPath, _grayMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved GRAYSCALE (1280x720) → {grayPath}");
            
            // Save downsampled frame (what the detector actually analyzes)
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            string smallPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_detection.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(smallPath, smallMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved DETECTION ({smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} with histogram eq) → {smallPath}");
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Frame {frameNum} SAVED SUCCESSFULLY! ✅✅✅");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to save debug frame: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    void OnDestroy()
    {
        if (_webCamTexture != null)
        {
            _webCamTexture.Stop();
        }
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        _grayMat?.Dispose();
    }
}

namespace OpenCvSharp.Unity
{
    public static class TextureConverter
    {
        public static Mat TextureToMat(Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = texture.width;
            int height = texture.height;
            Color32[] colors = texture.GetPixels32();
            Mat mat = new Mat(height, width, MatType.CV_8UC4);

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Color32 color = colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x];
                    var vec = new Vec4b(color.b, color.g, color.r, color.a);
                    mat.Set(y, x, vec);
                }
            }
            return mat;
        }

        public static void MatToTexture(Mat mat, Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = mat.Cols;
            int height = mat.Rows;
            Color32[] colors = new Color32[width * height];

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Vec4b color = mat.Get<Vec4b>(y, x);
                    colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x] = new Color32(color.Item2, color.Item1, color.Item0, color.Item3);
                }
            }
            
            texture.SetPixels32(colors);
            texture.Apply();
        }
    }
}
```

Ah! That's the issue! **You're not seeing the UI at all** because the RawImage isn't positioned correctly in AR space. 

On AR glasses like Magic Leap, UI elements need to be **positioned in 3D world space** in front of you, not just in a 2D canvas. The RawImage exists but it's probably positioned somewhere you can't see (behind you, too far away, or at the wrong depth).

Let me check your Unity scene setup:

Found it! The Canvas is set to **World Space** mode (which is correct for AR) and positioned at:
- Position: (0, 0, 1) - 1 meter forward
- Scale: 0.002 - very small
- Size: 1920x1080

**The problem:** The Canvas is positioned at a fixed location in world space `(0, 0, 1)`, but when you put on the Magic Leap, your camera/head might not be at the origin. **The display is probably behind you or way off to the side!**

**The solution:** Make the Canvas follow your head/camera so it's always in front of you. Let me create a simple script to attach the Canvas to the camera:

```csharp
using UnityEngine;

public class FollowCamera : MonoBehaviour
{
    public float distance = 2.0f;  // Distance in front of camera
    public bool followRotation = true;
    
    private Transform cameraTransform;
    
    void Start()
    {
        // Find the main camera
        cameraTransform = Camera.main.transform;
        
        if (cameraTransform == null)
        {
            Debug.LogError("FollowCamera: No main camera found!");
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.Log($"FollowCamera: Attached to camera {cameraTransform.name}");
        }
    }
    
    void LateUpdate()
    {
        if (cameraTransform == null) return;
        
        // Position the canvas in front of the camera
        transform.position = cameraTransform.position + cameraTransform.forward * distance;
        
        // Make it face the camera
        if (followRotation)
        {
            transform.rotation = cameraTransform.rotation;
        }
    }
}

```

**Cursor**

I can see from the logs that the `FollowCamera` script is working correctly - it's successfully attaching to the main camera and positioning the UI. The issue you're experiencing with not seeing the green boxes is likely related to the UI positioning or scale in the Magic Leap's AR space.

Let me analyze the current setup and make some adjustments to improve visibility:



I can see the issue! The `FollowCamera` script is using `LateUpdate()` instead of `Update()`, and there might be some timing issues. Also, let's check the current Canvas scale and make some adjustments to improve visibility.

Let me make several improvements:

1. **Reduce the distance** from 2 meters to 1 meter (as you suggested)
2. **Increase the Canvas scale** to make the UI more visible
3. **Add some debug logging** to confirm positioning
4. **Use Update() instead of LateUpdate()** for more consistent positioning


```csharp
using UnityEngine;

public class FollowCamera : MonoBehaviour
{
    public float distance = 1.0f;  // Reduced from 2.0f to 1.0f (1 meter instead of 2)
    public bool followRotation = true;
    
    private Transform cameraTransform;
    private int frameCount = 0;
    
    void Start()
    {
        // Find the main camera
        cameraTransform = Camera.main.transform;
        
        if (cameraTransform == null)
        {
            Debug.LogError("FollowCamera: No main camera found!");
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.Log($"FollowCamera: Attached to camera {cameraTransform.name}");
            Debug.Log($"FollowCamera: Distance set to {distance} meters");
        }
    }
    
    void Update()
    {
        if (cameraTransform == null) return;
        
        // Position the canvas in front of the camera
        Vector3 newPosition = cameraTransform.position + cameraTransform.forward * distance;
        transform.position = newPosition;
        
        // Make it face the camera
        if (followRotation)
        {
            transform.rotation = cameraTransform.rotation;
        }
        
        // Debug log every 60 frames (once per second at 60fps)
        frameCount++;
        if (frameCount % 60 == 0)
        {
            Debug.Log($"FollowCamera: Canvas at position {newPosition}, distance from camera: {Vector3.Distance(cameraTransform.position, newPosition):F2}m");
        }
    }
}


```

1. **Canvas scale is very small**: `m_LocalScale: {x: 0.002, y: 0.002, z: 0.002}` (line 576)
2. **FollowCamera script is attached**: The RawImage has the FollowCamera script with `distance: 2` (line 483)

The Canvas scale of 0.002 is extremely small! This means the UI is 500x smaller than normal, making it virtually invisible. Let's increase the Canvas scale significantly to make it more visible.

Perfect! Now let's also make the bounding boxes even more visible by increasing the thickness further and adding some additional visual enhancements to the FaceDetector script:


I can see the bounding box drawing code is already quite thick (line 293: thickness 10, line 295: thickness 5). Let's make the bounding boxes even more visible by adding multiple colored outlines and making them thicker:


```csharp

using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using OpenCvSharp;
using OpenCvSharp.Unity;
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.IO;
using UnityEngine.Networking;

public class FaceDetector : MonoBehaviour
{
    // Unity will auto-load native libraries from Assets/Plugins/Android/libs/x86_64/
    
    public RawImage DisplayImage;
    public float DetectionBoxScale = 2.0f;
    public int DownsampleFactor = 2;  // Changed from 4 to 2 for better detection

    private WebCamTexture _webCamTexture;
    private CascadeClassifier _cascade;
    private Mat _rgbaMat;
    private Mat _grayMat;
    private Texture2D _displayTexture;
    private bool _isInitialized = false;

    private const string CameraPermission = "android.permission.CAMERA";

    void Start()
    {
        Debug.Log($"FaceDetector starting - DisplayImage assigned: {DisplayImage != null}");
        StartCoroutine(CheckAndRequestPermissions());
    }

    private IEnumerator CheckAndRequestPermissions()
    {
        Debug.Log("Checking for camera permission...");

        if (UnityEngine.Android.Permission.HasUserAuthorizedPermission(CameraPermission))
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission already granted.");
            yield return StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission not yet granted. Requesting...");
            var callbacks = new UnityEngine.Android.PermissionCallbacks();
            callbacks.PermissionGranted += OnPermissionGranted;
            callbacks.PermissionDenied += OnPermissionDenied;
            callbacks.PermissionDeniedAndDontAskAgain += OnPermissionDenied;
            UnityEngine.Android.Permission.RequestUserPermission(CameraPermission, callbacks);
        }
    }

    private void OnPermissionGranted(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.Log($"Permission {permissionName} was granted. Proceeding with initialization.");
        StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
    }

    private void OnPermissionDenied(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.LogError($"Permission {permissionName} was denied. Face detection cannot start.");
    }

    private IEnumerator InitializeEverything()
    {
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZING WEBCAM ===");
        
        // Add timeout protection
        float timeout = 30f; // 30 seconds timeout
        float startTime = Time.time;
        
        // Get available cameras
        WebCamDevice[] devices = WebCamTexture.devices;
        Debug.Log($"Found {devices.Length} camera devices");
        
        if (devices.Length == 0)
        {
            Debug.LogError("ERROR: No cameras found on device!");
            yield break;
        }

        // Log available cameras
        for (int i = 0; i < devices.Length; i++)
        {
            Debug.Log($"Camera {i}: {devices[i].name} (Front: {devices[i].isFrontFacing})");
        }

        // Try Camera 2 instead - Camera 0 was completely black (tracking sensor, not RGB camera)
        // Magic Leap 2 has: 2 tracking sensors + 1 RGB camera on top
        int cameraIndex = 2;  // Try camera 2 (top RGB camera)
        Debug.Log($"🎥 Attempting to use Camera {cameraIndex}: {devices[cameraIndex].name}");
        _webCamTexture = new WebCamTexture(devices[cameraIndex].name, 1280, 720, 30);
        _webCamTexture.Play();

        Debug.Log($"Started camera: {devices[cameraIndex].name}, waiting for first frame...");
        int waitFrames = 0;
        while (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            waitFrames++;
            if (waitFrames > 300) // 10 seconds at 30fps
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Camera timeout! Camera playing: {_webCamTexture.isPlaying}, Size: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height}");
                yield break;
            }
            yield return null;
        }

        Debug.Log($"=== CAMERA STARTED: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height} @ {_webCamTexture.requestedFPS}fps ===");

        Debug.Log("OpenCV libraries should be auto-loaded by Unity from Plugins folder...");
        
        // Check timeout
        if (Time.time - startTime > timeout)
        {
            Debug.LogError("TIMEOUT: Initialization took too long!");
            yield break;
        }
        
        // Add a small delay to let Unity load the libraries
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
        
        try
        {
            Debug.Log("Testing OpenCV initialization...");
            // Try a simple OpenCV operation to test if libraries loaded
            using (var testMat = new Mat(1, 1, MatType.CV_8UC1))
            {
                Debug.Log($"OpenCV test Mat created successfully! Size: {testMat.Width}x{testMat.Height}");
            }
            Debug.Log("OpenCV library loaded successfully!");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR: OpenCV failed to initialize! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
            yield break;
        }
        
        Debug.Log("Loading Haar Cascade classifier...");
        string cascadePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
        
        using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(cascadePath))
        {
            yield return www.SendWebRequest();
            if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Failed to load haarcascade file: {www.error}");
                yield break;
            }
            
            string tempPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
            File.WriteAllBytes(tempPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
            Debug.Log($"Wrote cascade to: {tempPath}");
            
            try
            {
                Debug.Log($"Creating CascadeClassifier from: {tempPath}");
                _cascade = new CascadeClassifier(tempPath);
                Debug.Log("CascadeClassifier object created");
                
                if (_cascade.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogError("ERROR: Cascade classifier is empty!");
                    yield break;
                }
                Debug.Log("Cascade classifier loaded successfully!");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR creating CascadeClassifier! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
                Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
                if (ex.InnerException != null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"Inner exception: {ex.InnerException.GetType().Name}: {ex.InnerException.Message}");
                }
                yield break;
            }
        }

        Debug.Log($"Creating Mats and display texture ({_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height})...");
        _grayMat = new Mat(_webCamTexture.height, _webCamTexture.width, MatType.CV_8UC1);
        _displayTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false);
        
        if (DisplayImage != null)
        {
            DisplayImage.texture = _displayTexture;
            Debug.Log($"✅ Display texture assigned to RawImage - you'll see the camera feed with face boxes!");
            Debug.Log($"RawImage size: {DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.width}x{DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.height}");
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ WARNING: No RawImage found for display. Face detection is running but won't be visible.");
        }

        _isInitialized = true;
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZATION COMPLETE! Face detection should now be running. ===");
    }

    private int _frameCount = 0;
    private int _totalFacesDetected = 0;
    private bool _savedDebugFrames = false;
    
    void Update()
    {
        if (!_isInitialized || _webCamTexture == null || !_webCamTexture.isPlaying)
        {
            // Log why we're not processing (only every 60 frames to avoid spam)
            if (Time.frameCount % 60 == 0)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"Not processing: _isInitialized={_isInitialized}, _webCamTexture={_webCamTexture != null}, isPlaying={_webCamTexture?.isPlaying}");
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            return;
        }

        _frameCount++;
        
        // Log that we're actually processing
        if (_frameCount == 1)
        {
            Debug.Log("🎬 FIRST FRAME PROCESSING STARTED!");
        }
        
        try
        {
            TextureToMat();
            
            // Debug logging for first few frames
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: GrayMat size {_grayMat.Width}x{_grayMat.Height}, channels={_grayMat.Channels()}");
            }
            
            // Save debug frames (first 3 frames only)
            if (!_savedDebugFrames && _frameCount <= 3)
            {
                SaveDebugFrame(_frameCount);
                if (_frameCount == 3)
                {
                    _savedDebugFrames = true;
                    Debug.Log("✅ Debug frames saved! Use 'adb pull' to retrieve them from device.");
                }
            }
            
            // Downsample for performance
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            
            // Apply histogram equalization to improve contrast - VERY important for face detection!
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: SmallMat size {smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} for detection (with histogram equalization)");
            }

            // MUCH more relaxed detection parameters to test
            OpenCvSharp.Rect[] faces = _cascade.DetectMultiScale(
                image: smallMat,
                scaleFactor: 1.05,      // Smaller scale factor = more sensitive
                minNeighbors: 2,        // Even fewer neighbors = more detections (was 3)
                flags: HaarDetectionTypes.ScaleImage,
                minSize: new Size(15, 15)  // Smaller minimum size (was 20x20)
            );

            // Log detection results more frequently at first
            if (_frameCount <= 10 || (_frameCount % 30 == 0))
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: Detected {faces.Length} faces");
            }

            if (faces.Length > 0)
            {
                _totalFacesDetected += faces.Length;
                Debug.Log($"🟢 FACE DETECTED! Frame {_frameCount}: {faces.Length} face(s) - Drawing green boxes now!");
            }

            foreach (var face in faces)
            {
                var scaledRect = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(
                    face.X * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Y * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Width * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Height * DownsampleFactor
                );
                
                // Draw MULTIPLE THICK colored rectangles for maximum visibility!
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.Red, 15);        // Outer red border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.LimeGreen, 12);  // Green border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.Yellow, 8);      // Yellow inner border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.White, 4);       // White innermost border
            }

            MatToTexture();
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            // Log status every 5 seconds
            if (_frameCount % 150 == 0)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Status - Frame: {_frameCount}, Total faces found: {_totalFacesDetected}, Current faces: {faces.Length}");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"ERROR in Update: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    private void TextureToMat()
    {
        // Dispose the Mat from the previous frame to prevent a memory leak
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        
        // Convert WebCamTexture to Texture2D-compatible format
        Texture2D tempTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGB24, false);
        tempTexture.SetPixels32(_webCamTexture.GetPixels32());
        tempTexture.Apply();
        
        _rgbaMat = TextureConverter.TextureToMat(tempTexture);
        Destroy(tempTexture);
        
        Cv2.CvtColor(_rgbaMat, _grayMat, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
    }

    private void MatToTexture()
    {
        TextureConverter.MatToTexture(_rgbaMat, _displayTexture);
    }
    
    private void SaveDebugFrame(int frameNum)
    {
        try
        {
            // Use app's external files directory - no extra permissions needed!
            // This is at: /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.DefaultCompany.MagicLeap_Recogneyes/files/
            string saveDir = Application.persistentDataPath;
            
            Debug.Log($"💾 Saving debug frame {frameNum} to: {saveDir}");
            
            // Save original color frame
            string colorPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_original.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(colorPath, _rgbaMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved ORIGINAL (1280x720 color) → {colorPath}");
            
            // Save grayscale frame
            string grayPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_grayscale.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(grayPath, _grayMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved GRAYSCALE (1280x720) → {grayPath}");
            
            // Save downsampled frame (what the detector actually analyzes)
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            string smallPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_detection.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(smallPath, smallMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved DETECTION ({smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} with histogram eq) → {smallPath}");
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Frame {frameNum} SAVED SUCCESSFULLY! ✅✅✅");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to save debug frame: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    void OnDestroy()
    {
        if (_webCamTexture != null)
        {
            _webCamTexture.Stop();
        }
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        _grayMat?.Dispose();
    }
}

namespace OpenCvSharp.Unity
{
    public static class TextureConverter
    {
        public static Mat TextureToMat(Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = texture.width;
            int height = texture.height;
            Color32[] colors = texture.GetPixels32();
            Mat mat = new Mat(height, width, MatType.CV_8UC4);

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Color32 color = colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x];
                    var vec = new Vec4b(color.b, color.g, color.r, color.a);
                    mat.Set(y, x, vec);
                }
            }
            return mat;
        }

        public static void MatToTexture(Mat mat, Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = mat.Cols;
            int height = mat.Rows;
            Color32[] colors = new Color32[width * height];

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Vec4b color = mat.Get<Vec4b>(y, x);
                    colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x] = new Color32(color.Item2, color.Item1, color.Item0, color.Item3);
                }
            }
            
            texture.SetPixels32(colors);
            texture.Apply();
        }
    }
}
```

Perfect! Now let's create a summary of all the changes we've made to improve visibility:

## Summary of Changes Made

I've made several key improvements to make the face detection UI more visible on your Magic Leap 2:

### 1. **FollowCamera Script Improvements** (`FollowCamera.cs`)
- **Reduced distance** from 2 meters to 1 meter (as you suggested)
- **Changed from `LateUpdate()` to `Update()`** for more consistent positioning
- **Added debug logging** to track Canvas position every second

### 2. **Canvas Scale Increase** (`Face_Detection_OpenCV.unity`)
- **Increased Canvas scale** from `0.002` to `0.01` (5x larger!)
- **Updated FollowCamera distance** in scene file from 2 to 1 meter

### 3. **Enhanced Bounding Box Visibility** (`FaceDetector.cs`)
- **Multiple colored borders** for maximum visibility:
  - Red outer border (thickness 15)
  - Green border (thickness 12) 
  - Yellow inner border (thickness 8)
  - White innermost border (thickness 4)

### 4. **Debug Logging**
- Added position tracking in FollowCamera script
- Enhanced face detection logging

## What These Changes Do:

1. **1-meter distance**: The UI will now appear much closer to you (3.3 feet instead of 6.6 feet)
2. **5x larger scale**: The Canvas is now 5 times larger, making the camera feed and bounding boxes much more visible
3. **Multi-colored bounding boxes**: Even if one color doesn't show well, you'll have red, green, yellow, and white borders
4. **Better positioning**: The UI will more consistently follow your head movement

## Next Steps:

1. **Build and deploy** the updated application to your Magic Leap 2
2. **Test the visibility** - you should now see:
   - A much larger camera feed
   - The UI positioned 1 meter in front of you
   - Very thick, multi-colored bounding boxes around detected faces

The combination of these changes should make the face detection UI significantly more visible in your Magic Leap 2 headset. The 1-meter distance should be perfect for seeing the camera feed and bounding boxes clearly!

hm still nothing ? wonder what the issue could be 

---

**Cursor**

Looking at the logs, I can see that:

1. ✅ **Face detection is working perfectly** - detecting 1-4 faces consistently
2. ✅ **FollowCamera is working** - positioning the Canvas at 1 meter: `"Canvas at position (0.59, -0.19, 0.56), distance from camera: 1.00m"`
3. ✅ **Bounding boxes are being drawn** - "Drawing green boxes now!" appears repeatedly
4. ✅ **Display texture is assigned** - "Display texture assigned to RawImage"

But you're still not seeing anything. Looking at the `FollowCamera` positioning log, I notice the Canvas is positioned at **(0.59, -0.19, 0.56)** which seems like it might be **off to the side and slightly below** your view.

The issue is likely that **the Canvas is positioned 1 meter forward from the camera's current position, but NOT necessarily in front of where you're looking**. In AR, the camera can be at position (0,0,0) but you might be looking in a different direction.

Let me check one critical thing - I just realized the `FollowCamera` script might be attached to the **RawImage** instead of the **Canvas**! Looking at the scene file from earlier:

```yaml
--- !u!114 &1551400318
MonoBehaviour:
  ...
  m_GameObject: {fileID: 1551400314}  # This is the RawImage
  ...
  m_Script: {fileID: 11500000, guid: 11cec6050033b824282e763685638de6, type: 3}
  ...
  distance: 1
```

**That's the problem!** The `FollowCamera` script is attached to the **RawImage (child object)**, not the **Canvas (parent object)**. This means only the RawImage is moving, but since it's a child of the Canvas, the Canvas transform is overriding its position!

Let me fix this:

```yaml
--- !u!114 &1551400318
MonoBehaviour:
  ...
  m_GameObject: {fileID: 1551400314}  # This is the RawImage
  ...
  m_Script: {fileID: 11500000, guid: 11cec6050033b824282e763685638de6, type: 3}
  ...
  distance: 1
```

Perfect! Now I've made the critical fix:

## **The Problem Was Found!**

The `FollowCamera` script was attached to the **RawImage** (child object) instead of the **Canvas** (parent object). This meant:
- The RawImage was trying to move to follow the camera
- But the Canvas (its parent) was staying at a fixed position (0, 0, 1)
- The child's movement was being overridden by the parent's transform

## **What I Fixed:**

1. **Disabled** the `FollowCamera` script on the RawImage (set `m_Enabled: 0`)
2. **Added** the `FollowCamera` script to the Canvas itself
3. The Canvas will now properly follow the camera at 1 meter distance

## **Summary of All Changes:**

✅ **FollowCamera script** - Now correctly attached to Canvas, set to 1 meter distance  
✅ **Canvas scale** - Increased from 0.002 to 0.01 (5x larger)  
✅ **Bounding boxes** - Multiple thick colored borders (Red 15px, Green 12px, Yellow 8px, White 4px)  
✅ **Face detection** - Working perfectly, detecting faces consistently

Now when you **build and deploy** the application:
- The **entire Canvas** (including the camera feed and bounding boxes) will follow your head
- It will stay **1 meter in front of you** at all times
- The UI will be **5x larger** than before
- The bounding boxes will be **very thick and multi-colored**

This should finally make everything visible! The key was that the script needed to move the whole Canvas, not just the image inside it.

**Cursor**

You're right to be cautious! Let me add some additional safety measures and debug logging to make absolutely sure we can see what's happening:

Let me enhance the `FollowCamera` script with MORE visible logging and also add a visual indicator to the script itself:

```csharp
using UnityEngine;

public class FollowCamera : MonoBehaviour
{
    public float distance = 0.5f;  // Changed to 0.5 meters - even closer!
    public bool followRotation = true;
    
    private Transform cameraTransform;
    private int frameCount = 0;
    
    void Start()
    {
        // Find the main camera
        cameraTransform = Camera.main.transform;
        
        if (cameraTransform == null)
        {
            Debug.LogError("❌❌❌ FollowCamera: No main camera found! ❌❌❌");
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ FollowCamera: SUCCESSFULLY attached to GameObject '{gameObject.name}' following camera '{cameraTransform.name}' ✅✅✅");
            Debug.Log($"📏 FollowCamera: Distance set to {distance} meters");
            Debug.Log($"📐 FollowCamera: Canvas scale is {transform.localScale}");
            Debug.Log($"🔄 FollowCamera: Follow rotation = {followRotation}");
        }
    }
    
    void Update()
    {
        if (cameraTransform == null) return;
        
        // Position the canvas in front of the camera
        Vector3 newPosition = cameraTransform.position + cameraTransform.forward * distance;
        transform.position = newPosition;
        
        // Make it face the camera
        if (followRotation)
        {
            transform.rotation = cameraTransform.rotation;
        }
        
        // More frequent logging at first, then every 60 frames
        frameCount++;
        if (frameCount <= 10 || frameCount % 60 == 0)
        {
            Debug.Log($"🎯 FollowCamera Frame {frameCount}: Canvas at {newPosition}, Camera at {cameraTransform.position}, Distance: {Vector3.Distance(cameraTransform.position, newPosition):F2}m");
            Debug.Log($"📊 FollowCamera Frame {frameCount}: Canvas rotation {transform.rotation.eulerAngles}, Camera rotation {cameraTransform.rotation.eulerAngles}");
        }
    }
}


```

```csharp

using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using OpenCvSharp;
using OpenCvSharp.Unity;
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.IO;
using UnityEngine.Networking;

public class FaceDetector : MonoBehaviour
{
    // Unity will auto-load native libraries from Assets/Plugins/Android/libs/x86_64/
    
    public RawImage DisplayImage;
    public float DetectionBoxScale = 2.0f;
    public int DownsampleFactor = 2;  // Changed from 4 to 2 for better detection

    private WebCamTexture _webCamTexture;
    private CascadeClassifier _cascade;
    private Mat _rgbaMat;
    private Mat _grayMat;
    private Texture2D _displayTexture;
    private bool _isInitialized = false;

    private const string CameraPermission = "android.permission.CAMERA";

    void Start()
    {
        Debug.Log($"FaceDetector starting - DisplayImage assigned: {DisplayImage != null}");
        StartCoroutine(CheckAndRequestPermissions());
    }

    private IEnumerator CheckAndRequestPermissions()
    {
        Debug.Log("Checking for camera permission...");

        if (UnityEngine.Android.Permission.HasUserAuthorizedPermission(CameraPermission))
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission already granted.");
            yield return StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission not yet granted. Requesting...");
            var callbacks = new UnityEngine.Android.PermissionCallbacks();
            callbacks.PermissionGranted += OnPermissionGranted;
            callbacks.PermissionDenied += OnPermissionDenied;
            callbacks.PermissionDeniedAndDontAskAgain += OnPermissionDenied;
            UnityEngine.Android.Permission.RequestUserPermission(CameraPermission, callbacks);
        }
    }

    private void OnPermissionGranted(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.Log($"Permission {permissionName} was granted. Proceeding with initialization.");
        StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
    }

    private void OnPermissionDenied(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.LogError($"Permission {permissionName} was denied. Face detection cannot start.");
    }

    private IEnumerator InitializeEverything()
    {
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZING WEBCAM ===");
        
        // Add timeout protection
        float timeout = 30f; // 30 seconds timeout
        float startTime = Time.time;
        
        // Get available cameras
        WebCamDevice[] devices = WebCamTexture.devices;
        Debug.Log($"Found {devices.Length} camera devices");
        
        if (devices.Length == 0)
        {
            Debug.LogError("ERROR: No cameras found on device!");
            yield break;
        }

        // Log available cameras
        for (int i = 0; i < devices.Length; i++)
        {
            Debug.Log($"Camera {i}: {devices[i].name} (Front: {devices[i].isFrontFacing})");
        }

        // Try Camera 2 instead - Camera 0 was completely black (tracking sensor, not RGB camera)
        // Magic Leap 2 has: 2 tracking sensors + 1 RGB camera on top
        int cameraIndex = 2;  // Try camera 2 (top RGB camera)
        Debug.Log($"🎥 Attempting to use Camera {cameraIndex}: {devices[cameraIndex].name}");
        _webCamTexture = new WebCamTexture(devices[cameraIndex].name, 1280, 720, 30);
        _webCamTexture.Play();

        Debug.Log($"Started camera: {devices[cameraIndex].name}, waiting for first frame...");
        int waitFrames = 0;
        while (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            waitFrames++;
            if (waitFrames > 300) // 10 seconds at 30fps
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Camera timeout! Camera playing: {_webCamTexture.isPlaying}, Size: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height}");
                yield break;
            }
            yield return null;
        }

        Debug.Log($"=== CAMERA STARTED: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height} @ {_webCamTexture.requestedFPS}fps ===");

        Debug.Log("OpenCV libraries should be auto-loaded by Unity from Plugins folder...");
        
        // Check timeout
        if (Time.time - startTime > timeout)
        {
            Debug.LogError("TIMEOUT: Initialization took too long!");
            yield break;
        }
        
        // Add a small delay to let Unity load the libraries
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
        
        try
        {
            Debug.Log("Testing OpenCV initialization...");
            // Try a simple OpenCV operation to test if libraries loaded
            using (var testMat = new Mat(1, 1, MatType.CV_8UC1))
            {
                Debug.Log($"OpenCV test Mat created successfully! Size: {testMat.Width}x{testMat.Height}");
            }
            Debug.Log("OpenCV library loaded successfully!");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR: OpenCV failed to initialize! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
            yield break;
        }
        
        Debug.Log("Loading Haar Cascade classifier...");
        string cascadePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
        
        using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(cascadePath))
        {
            yield return www.SendWebRequest();
            if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Failed to load haarcascade file: {www.error}");
                yield break;
            }
            
            string tempPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
            File.WriteAllBytes(tempPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
            Debug.Log($"Wrote cascade to: {tempPath}");
            
            try
            {
                Debug.Log($"Creating CascadeClassifier from: {tempPath}");
                _cascade = new CascadeClassifier(tempPath);
                Debug.Log("CascadeClassifier object created");
                
                if (_cascade.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogError("ERROR: Cascade classifier is empty!");
                    yield break;
                }
                Debug.Log("Cascade classifier loaded successfully!");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR creating CascadeClassifier! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
                Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
                if (ex.InnerException != null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"Inner exception: {ex.InnerException.GetType().Name}: {ex.InnerException.Message}");
                }
                yield break;
            }
        }

        Debug.Log($"Creating Mats and display texture ({_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height})...");
        _grayMat = new Mat(_webCamTexture.height, _webCamTexture.width, MatType.CV_8UC1);
        _displayTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false);
        
        if (DisplayImage != null)
        {
            DisplayImage.texture = _displayTexture;
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Display texture assigned to RawImage - you'll see the camera feed with face boxes! ✅✅✅");
            Debug.Log($"📱 RawImage size: {DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.width}x{DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.height}");
            
            // Get Canvas info
            var canvas = DisplayImage.GetComponentInParent<Canvas>();
            if (canvas != null)
            {
                Debug.Log($"🖼️ Canvas found! Name: '{canvas.gameObject.name}', Position: {canvas.transform.position}, Scale: {canvas.transform.localScale}");
                Debug.Log($"🎨 Canvas Render Mode: {canvas.renderMode}");
                
                // Check if FollowCamera is attached
                var followCam = canvas.GetComponent<FollowCamera>();
                if (followCam != null)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"✅ FollowCamera script IS attached to Canvas!");
                }
                else
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"❌❌❌ FollowCamera script NOT found on Canvas! ❌❌❌");
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ No Canvas parent found for RawImage!");
            }
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ WARNING: No RawImage found for display. Face detection is running but won't be visible.");
        }

        _isInitialized = true;
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZATION COMPLETE! Face detection should now be running. ===");
    }

    private int _frameCount = 0;
    private int _totalFacesDetected = 0;
    private bool _savedDebugFrames = false;
    
    void Update()
    {
        if (!_isInitialized || _webCamTexture == null || !_webCamTexture.isPlaying)
        {
            // Log why we're not processing (only every 60 frames to avoid spam)
            if (Time.frameCount % 60 == 0)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"Not processing: _isInitialized={_isInitialized}, _webCamTexture={_webCamTexture != null}, isPlaying={_webCamTexture?.isPlaying}");
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            return;
        }

        _frameCount++;
        
        // Log that we're actually processing
        if (_frameCount == 1)
        {
            Debug.Log("🎬 FIRST FRAME PROCESSING STARTED!");
        }
        
        try
        {
            TextureToMat();
            
            // Debug logging for first few frames
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: GrayMat size {_grayMat.Width}x{_grayMat.Height}, channels={_grayMat.Channels()}");
            }
            
            // Save debug frames (first 3 frames only)
            if (!_savedDebugFrames && _frameCount <= 3)
            {
                SaveDebugFrame(_frameCount);
                if (_frameCount == 3)
                {
                    _savedDebugFrames = true;
                    Debug.Log("✅ Debug frames saved! Use 'adb pull' to retrieve them from device.");
                }
            }
            
            // Downsample for performance
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            
            // Apply histogram equalization to improve contrast - VERY important for face detection!
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: SmallMat size {smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} for detection (with histogram equalization)");
            }

            // MUCH more relaxed detection parameters to test
            OpenCvSharp.Rect[] faces = _cascade.DetectMultiScale(
                image: smallMat,
                scaleFactor: 1.05,      // Smaller scale factor = more sensitive
                minNeighbors: 2,        // Even fewer neighbors = more detections (was 3)
                flags: HaarDetectionTypes.ScaleImage,
                minSize: new Size(15, 15)  // Smaller minimum size (was 20x20)
            );

            // Log detection results more frequently at first
            if (_frameCount <= 10 || (_frameCount % 30 == 0))
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: Detected {faces.Length} faces");
            }

            if (faces.Length > 0)
            {
                _totalFacesDetected += faces.Length;
                Debug.Log($"🟢 FACE DETECTED! Frame {_frameCount}: {faces.Length} face(s) - Drawing green boxes now!");
            }

            foreach (var face in faces)
            {
                var scaledRect = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(
                    face.X * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Y * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Width * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Height * DownsampleFactor
                );
                
                // Draw MULTIPLE THICK colored rectangles for maximum visibility!
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.Red, 15);        // Outer red border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.LimeGreen, 12);  // Green border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.Yellow, 8);      // Yellow inner border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.White, 4);       // White innermost border
            }

            MatToTexture();
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            // Log status every 5 seconds
            if (_frameCount % 150 == 0)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Status - Frame: {_frameCount}, Total faces found: {_totalFacesDetected}, Current faces: {faces.Length}");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"ERROR in Update: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    private void TextureToMat()
    {
        // Dispose the Mat from the previous frame to prevent a memory leak
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        
        // Convert WebCamTexture to Texture2D-compatible format
        Texture2D tempTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGB24, false);
        tempTexture.SetPixels32(_webCamTexture.GetPixels32());
        tempTexture.Apply();
        
        _rgbaMat = TextureConverter.TextureToMat(tempTexture);
        Destroy(tempTexture);
        
        Cv2.CvtColor(_rgbaMat, _grayMat, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
    }

    private void MatToTexture()
    {
        TextureConverter.MatToTexture(_rgbaMat, _displayTexture);
    }
    
    private void SaveDebugFrame(int frameNum)
    {
        try
        {
            // Use app's external files directory - no extra permissions needed!
            // This is at: /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.DefaultCompany.MagicLeap_Recogneyes/files/
            string saveDir = Application.persistentDataPath;
            
            Debug.Log($"💾 Saving debug frame {frameNum} to: {saveDir}");
            
            // Save original color frame
            string colorPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_original.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(colorPath, _rgbaMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved ORIGINAL (1280x720 color) → {colorPath}");
            
            // Save grayscale frame
            string grayPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_grayscale.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(grayPath, _grayMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved GRAYSCALE (1280x720) → {grayPath}");
            
            // Save downsampled frame (what the detector actually analyzes)
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            string smallPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_detection.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(smallPath, smallMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved DETECTION ({smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} with histogram eq) → {smallPath}");
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Frame {frameNum} SAVED SUCCESSFULLY! ✅✅✅");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to save debug frame: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    void OnDestroy()
    {
        if (_webCamTexture != null)
        {
            _webCamTexture.Stop();
        }
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        _grayMat?.Dispose();
    }
}

namespace OpenCvSharp.Unity
{
    public static class TextureConverter
    {
        public static Mat TextureToMat(Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = texture.width;
            int height = texture.height;
            Color32[] colors = texture.GetPixels32();
            Mat mat = new Mat(height, width, MatType.CV_8UC4);

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Color32 color = colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x];
                    var vec = new Vec4b(color.b, color.g, color.r, color.a);
                    mat.Set(y, x, vec);
                }
            }
            return mat;
        }

        public static void MatToTexture(Mat mat, Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = mat.Cols;
            int height = mat.Rows;
            Color32[] colors = new Color32[width * height];

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Vec4b color = mat.Get<Vec4b>(y, x);
                    colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x] = new Color32(color.Item2, color.Item1, color.Item0, color.Item3);
                }
            }
            
            texture.SetPixels32(colors);
            texture.Apply();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

/// <summary>
/// This script adds a bright colored background to the Canvas to make it IMPOSSIBLE to miss.
/// Remove this script once you confirm the UI is visible.
/// </summary>
public class CanvasDebugHelper : MonoBehaviour
{
    void Start()
    {
        // Add a bright red background to the Canvas to make it visible
        var canvas = GetComponent<Canvas>();
        if (canvas == null)
        {
            Debug.LogError("❌ CanvasDebugHelper: No Canvas component found!");
            return;
        }

        // Create a full-screen red background image
        GameObject bgObject = new GameObject("DEBUG_RedBackground");
        bgObject.transform.SetParent(transform, false);
        
        RectTransform bgRect = bgObject.AddComponent<RectTransform>();
        bgRect.anchorMin = Vector2.zero;
        bgRect.anchorMax = Vector2.one;
        bgRect.sizeDelta = Vector2.zero;
        bgRect.anchoredPosition = Vector2.zero;
        
        Image bgImage = bgObject.AddComponent<Image>();
        bgImage.color = new Color(1f, 0f, 0f, 0.5f); // Bright red with 50% transparency
        
        // Make sure it's behind everything else
        bgRect.SetAsFirstSibling();
        
        Debug.Log("🔴🔴🔴 CanvasDebugHelper: Added BRIGHT RED background to Canvas - if you see RED, the Canvas is working! 🔴🔴🔴");
        Debug.Log($"🔴 Canvas position: {transform.position}, scale: {transform.localScale}");
    }
}
```

## **🎯 FINAL COMPREHENSIVE FIX - What We Changed & What to Expect**

### **✅ Critical Fixes Made:**

1. **FollowCamera Script Location (THE BIG FIX!)**
   - ❌ **WAS**: Attached to RawImage (child) - didn't work because parent Canvas was overriding its position
   - ✅ **NOW**: Attached to Canvas (parent) - will properly follow the camera

2. **Distance Reduced**
   - Changed from 2 meters → **0.5 meters (1.6 feet)**
   - The UI will be VERY close to you, impossible to miss

3. **Canvas Scale Increased**
   - Increased from `0.002` → `0.01` (5x larger)
   - The display will be much bigger and more visible

4. **Bounding Boxes Enhanced**
   - **4 colored borders**: Red (15px), Green (12px), Yellow (8px), White (4px)
   - Super thick and multi-colored for maximum visibility

5. **🔴 RED BACKGROUND ADDED (Debug Helper)**
   - Added a **bright red semi-transparent background** to the entire Canvas
   - If you see ANY red at all, the Canvas is visible and working
   - You can remove this script later once confirmed working

The logs confirm everything is working perfectly in code - the FollowCamera is attached to the Canvas, the red background was added, and it's tracking correctly. But you're not seeing **anything** - not even the red background.

This is a **critical clue**: The issue is that **World Space Canvas UI doesn't render to the Magic Leap 2's AR displays**. The Canvas is rendering in the scene, but Magic Leap 2 uses OpenXR which has special rendering requirements.

Let me check the Canvas camera assignment - I bet the Canvas isn't assigned to the correct camera for AR rendering:

I found it! The Canvas **is** assigned to a camera (`m_Camera: {fileID: 1245021032}` - which is the Main Camera), and it's in World Space mode (`m_RenderMode: 2`). 

The problem is that **World Space Canvas doesn't work well with XR/AR headsets** because the rendering goes to the XR display, not the Unity scene camera.

Let me search for the proper way to display overlays on Magic Leap 2:

Perfect! I found a critical resource - there's an actual **Magic Leap with Dlib Face Landmark Detector Example** on GitHub! Let me search for more specific info about how they display the UI:

Based on the research and the logs, I've identified the core issue: **World Space Canvas in Unity doesn't render to Magic Leap 2's AR displays by default**. The Canvas is rendering in the Unity scene but not being submitted to the XR compositor.

Here's what I think the issue is and the solution:

## **The Real Problem:**

Your Canvas is set to **World Space** mode, which means it exists in the 3D world, but Magic Leap 2 uses **OpenXR rendering** which requires UI to be rendered differently. The Canvas needs to either:

1. **Use Overlay mode** (Screen Space - Overlay)
2. **Be rendered on a 3D mesh** (like a Quad with a RenderTexture)
3. **Use the Segmented Dimmer** for overlays

Let me try the simplest solution first - **change the Canvas to Screen Space - Overlay mode**, which should render directly to the headset display:
