```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using OpenCvSharp;
using OpenCvSharp.Unity;
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.IO;
using UnityEngine.Networking;

public class FaceDetector : MonoBehaviour
{
    // Unity will auto-load native libraries from Assets/Plugins/Android/libs/x86_64/
    
    public RawImage DisplayImage;
    public float DetectionBoxScale = 2.0f;
    public int DownsampleFactor = 2;  // Changed from 4 to 2 for better detection

    private WebCamTexture _webCamTexture;
    private CascadeClassifier _cascade;
    private Mat _rgbaMat;
    private Mat _grayMat;
    private Texture2D _displayTexture;
    private bool _isInitialized = false;

    private const string CameraPermission = "android.permission.CAMERA";

    void Start()
    {
        Debug.Log($"FaceDetector starting - DisplayImage assigned: {DisplayImage != null}");
        StartCoroutine(CheckAndRequestPermissions());
    }

    private IEnumerator CheckAndRequestPermissions()
    {
        Debug.Log("Checking for camera permission...");

        if (UnityEngine.Android.Permission.HasUserAuthorizedPermission(CameraPermission))
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission already granted.");
            yield return StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission not yet granted. Requesting...");
            var callbacks = new UnityEngine.Android.PermissionCallbacks();
            callbacks.PermissionGranted += OnPermissionGranted;
            callbacks.PermissionDenied += OnPermissionDenied;
            callbacks.PermissionDeniedAndDontAskAgain += OnPermissionDenied;
            UnityEngine.Android.Permission.RequestUserPermission(CameraPermission, callbacks);
        }
    }

    private void OnPermissionGranted(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.Log($"Permission {permissionName} was granted. Proceeding with initialization.");
        StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
    }

    private void OnPermissionDenied(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.LogError($"Permission {permissionName} was denied. Face detection cannot start.");
    }

    private IEnumerator InitializeEverything()
    {
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZING WEBCAM ===");
        
        // Add timeout protection
        float timeout = 30f; // 30 seconds timeout
        float startTime = Time.time;
        
        // Get available cameras
        WebCamDevice[] devices = WebCamTexture.devices;
        Debug.Log($"Found {devices.Length} camera devices");
        
        if (devices.Length == 0)
        {
            Debug.LogError("ERROR: No cameras found on device!");
            yield break;
        }

        // Log available cameras
        for (int i = 0; i < devices.Length; i++)
        {
            Debug.Log($"Camera {i}: {devices[i].name} (Front: {devices[i].isFrontFacing})");
        }

        // Try Camera 2 instead - Camera 0 was completely black (tracking sensor, not RGB camera)
        // Magic Leap 2 has: 2 tracking sensors + 1 RGB camera on top
        int cameraIndex = 2;  // Try camera 2 (top RGB camera)
        Debug.Log($"🎥 Attempting to use Camera {cameraIndex}: {devices[cameraIndex].name}");
        _webCamTexture = new WebCamTexture(devices[cameraIndex].name, 1280, 720, 30);
        _webCamTexture.Play();

        Debug.Log($"Started camera: {devices[cameraIndex].name}, waiting for first frame...");
        int waitFrames = 0;
        while (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            waitFrames++;
            if (waitFrames > 300) // 10 seconds at 30fps
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Camera timeout! Camera playing: {_webCamTexture.isPlaying}, Size: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height}");
                yield break;
            }
            yield return null;
        }

        Debug.Log($"=== CAMERA STARTED: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height} @ {_webCamTexture.requestedFPS}fps ===");

        Debug.Log("OpenCV libraries should be auto-loaded by Unity from Plugins folder...");
        
        // Check timeout
        if (Time.time - startTime > timeout)
        {
            Debug.LogError("TIMEOUT: Initialization took too long!");
            yield break;
        }
        
        // Add a small delay to let Unity load the libraries
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
        
        try
        {
            Debug.Log("Testing OpenCV initialization...");
            // Try a simple OpenCV operation to test if libraries loaded
            using (var testMat = new Mat(1, 1, MatType.CV_8UC1))
            {
                Debug.Log($"OpenCV test Mat created successfully! Size: {testMat.Width}x{testMat.Height}");
            }
            Debug.Log("OpenCV library loaded successfully!");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR: OpenCV failed to initialize! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
            yield break;
        }
        
        Debug.Log("Loading Haar Cascade classifier...");
        string cascadePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
        
        using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(cascadePath))
        {
            yield return www.SendWebRequest();
            if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Failed to load haarcascade file: {www.error}");
                yield break;
            }
            
            string tempPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
            File.WriteAllBytes(tempPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
            Debug.Log($"Wrote cascade to: {tempPath}");
            
            try
            {
                Debug.Log($"Creating CascadeClassifier from: {tempPath}");
                _cascade = new CascadeClassifier(tempPath);
                Debug.Log("CascadeClassifier object created");
                
                if (_cascade.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogError("ERROR: Cascade classifier is empty!");
                    yield break;
                }
                Debug.Log("Cascade classifier loaded successfully!");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR creating CascadeClassifier! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
                Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
                if (ex.InnerException != null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"Inner exception: {ex.InnerException.GetType().Name}: {ex.InnerException.Message}");
                }
                yield break;
            }
        }

        Debug.Log($"Creating Mats and display texture ({_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height})...");
        _grayMat = new Mat(_webCamTexture.height, _webCamTexture.width, MatType.CV_8UC1);
        _displayTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false);
        
        if (DisplayImage != null)
        {
            DisplayImage.texture = _displayTexture;
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Display texture assigned to RawImage - you'll see the camera feed with face boxes! ✅✅✅");
            Debug.Log($"📱 RawImage size: {DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.width}x{DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.height}");
            
            // Get Canvas info
            var canvas = DisplayImage.GetComponentInParent<Canvas>();
            if (canvas != null)
            {
                Debug.Log($"🖼️ Canvas found! Name: '{canvas.gameObject.name}', Position: {canvas.transform.position}, Scale: {canvas.transform.localScale}");
                Debug.Log($"🎨 Canvas Render Mode: {canvas.renderMode} (0=ScreenSpaceOverlay, 1=ScreenSpaceCamera, 2=WorldSpace)");
                
                if (canvas.renderMode == RenderMode.ScreenSpaceOverlay)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Canvas is set to SCREEN SPACE OVERLAY - This should render to AR headset! ✅✅✅");
                }
                else if (canvas.renderMode == RenderMode.WorldSpace)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️⚠️⚠️ Canvas is WORLD SPACE - This may NOT render to AR headset displays! ⚠️⚠️⚠️");
                }
                
                // Check if FollowCamera is attached
                var followCam = canvas.GetComponent<FollowCamera>();
                if (followCam != null)
                {
                    if (followCam.enabled)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"✅ FollowCamera script IS attached and ENABLED on Canvas!");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"ℹ️ FollowCamera script is attached but DISABLED (OK for ScreenSpaceOverlay mode)");
                    }
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ No Canvas parent found for RawImage!");
            }
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ WARNING: No RawImage found for display. Face detection is running but won't be visible.");
        }

        _isInitialized = true;
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZATION COMPLETE! Face detection should now be running. ===");
    }

    private int _frameCount = 0;
    private int _totalFacesDetected = 0;
    private bool _savedDebugFrames = false;
    
    void Update()
    {
        if (!_isInitialized || _webCamTexture == null || !_webCamTexture.isPlaying)
        {
            // Log why we're not processing (only every 60 frames to avoid spam)
            if (Time.frameCount % 60 == 0)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"Not processing: _isInitialized={_isInitialized}, _webCamTexture={_webCamTexture != null}, isPlaying={_webCamTexture?.isPlaying}");
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            return;
        }

        _frameCount++;
        
        // Log that we're actually processing
        if (_frameCount == 1)
        {
            Debug.Log("🎬 FIRST FRAME PROCESSING STARTED!");
        }
        
        try
        {
            TextureToMat();
            
            // Debug logging for first few frames
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: GrayMat size {_grayMat.Width}x{_grayMat.Height}, channels={_grayMat.Channels()}");
            }
            
            // Save debug frames (first 3 frames only)
            if (!_savedDebugFrames && _frameCount <= 3)
            {
                SaveDebugFrame(_frameCount);
                if (_frameCount == 3)
                {
                    _savedDebugFrames = true;
                    Debug.Log("✅ Debug frames saved! Use 'adb pull' to retrieve them from device.");
                }
            }
            
            // Downsample for performance
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            
            // Apply histogram equalization to improve contrast - VERY important for face detection!
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: SmallMat size {smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} for detection (with histogram equalization)");
            }

            // MUCH more relaxed detection parameters to test
            OpenCvSharp.Rect[] faces = _cascade.DetectMultiScale(
                image: smallMat,
                scaleFactor: 1.05,      // Smaller scale factor = more sensitive
                minNeighbors: 2,        // Even fewer neighbors = more detections (was 3)
                flags: HaarDetectionTypes.ScaleImage,
                minSize: new Size(15, 15)  // Smaller minimum size (was 20x20)
            );

            // Log detection results more frequently at first
            if (_frameCount <= 10 || (_frameCount % 30 == 0))
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: Detected {faces.Length} faces");
            }

            if (faces.Length > 0)
            {
                _totalFacesDetected += faces.Length;
                Debug.Log($"🟢 FACE DETECTED! Frame {_frameCount}: {faces.Length} face(s) - Drawing green boxes now!");
            }

            foreach (var face in faces)
            {
                var scaledRect = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(
                    face.X * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Y * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Width * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Height * DownsampleFactor
                );
                
                // Draw MULTIPLE THICK colored rectangles for maximum visibility!
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.Red, 15);        // Outer red border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.LimeGreen, 12);  // Green border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.Yellow, 8);      // Yellow inner border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.White, 4);       // White innermost border
            }

            MatToTexture();
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            // Log status every 5 seconds
            if (_frameCount % 150 == 0)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Status - Frame: {_frameCount}, Total faces found: {_totalFacesDetected}, Current faces: {faces.Length}");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"ERROR in Update: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    private void TextureToMat()
    {
        // Dispose the Mat from the previous frame to prevent a memory leak
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        
        // Convert WebCamTexture to Texture2D-compatible format
        Texture2D tempTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGB24, false);
        tempTexture.SetPixels32(_webCamTexture.GetPixels32());
        tempTexture.Apply();
        
        _rgbaMat = TextureConverter.TextureToMat(tempTexture);
        Destroy(tempTexture);
        
        Cv2.CvtColor(_rgbaMat, _grayMat, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
    }

    private void MatToTexture()
    {
        TextureConverter.MatToTexture(_rgbaMat, _displayTexture);
    }
    
    private void SaveDebugFrame(int frameNum)
    {
        try
        {
            // Use app's external files directory - no extra permissions needed!
            // This is at: /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.DefaultCompany.MagicLeap_Recogneyes/files/
            string saveDir = Application.persistentDataPath;
            
            Debug.Log($"💾 Saving debug frame {frameNum} to: {saveDir}");
            
            // Save original color frame
            string colorPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_original.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(colorPath, _rgbaMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved ORIGINAL (1280x720 color) → {colorPath}");
            
            // Save grayscale frame
            string grayPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_grayscale.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(grayPath, _grayMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved GRAYSCALE (1280x720) → {grayPath}");
            
            // Save downsampled frame (what the detector actually analyzes)
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            string smallPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_detection.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(smallPath, smallMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved DETECTION ({smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} with histogram eq) → {smallPath}");
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Frame {frameNum} SAVED SUCCESSFULLY! ✅✅✅");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to save debug frame: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    void OnDestroy()
    {
        if (_webCamTexture != null)
        {
            _webCamTexture.Stop();
        }
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        _grayMat?.Dispose();
    }
}

namespace OpenCvSharp.Unity
{
    public static class TextureConverter
    {
        public static Mat TextureToMat(Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = texture.width;
            int height = texture.height;
            Color32[] colors = texture.GetPixels32();
            Mat mat = new Mat(height, width, MatType.CV_8UC4);

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Color32 color = colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x];
                    var vec = new Vec4b(color.b, color.g, color.r, color.a);
                    mat.Set(y, x, vec);
                }
            }
            return mat;
        }

        public static void MatToTexture(Mat mat, Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = mat.Cols;
            int height = mat.Rows;
            Color32[] colors = new Color32[width * height];

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Vec4b color = mat.Get<Vec4b>(y, x);
                    colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x] = new Color32(color.Item2, color.Item1, color.Item0, color.Item3);
                }
            }
            
            texture.SetPixels32(colors);
            texture.Apply();
        }
    }
}
```

Perfect! Now let me create a summary document explaining what I discovered and what should happen:

## **🎯 CRITICAL DISCOVERY - The Real Problem!**

### **What Was Wrong:**

The Canvas was set to **World Space** mode (`m_RenderMode: 2`), which means:
- ❌ The Canvas exists in the 3D Unity scene
- ❌ But Magic Leap 2 uses **OpenXR rendering** which renders to the AR displays separately
- ❌ World Space UI doesn't automatically get submitted to the XR compositor
- ❌ That's why you saw NOTHING - not even the red background!

### **The Fix:**

I changed the Canvas to **Screen Space - Overlay** mode (`m_RenderMode: 0`), which means:
- ✅ The Canvas renders **directly to the display** (bypasses the 3D scene)
- ✅ Always visible in AR headsets
- ✅ Always in front of the camera view
- ✅ No need for the FollowCamera script (disabled it)
- ✅ Scale reset to 1,1,1 (normal size)

### **What Changed:**

1. **Canvas Render Mode**: `WorldSpace (2)` → `ScreenSpaceOverlay (0)`
2. **Canvas Camera**: Removed camera assignment (not needed for Overlay)
3. **Canvas Scale**: `(0.01, 0.01, 0.01)` → `(1, 1, 1)` 
4. **Canvas Position**: `(0, 0, 1)` → `(0, 0, 0)`
5. **FollowCamera Script**: Disabled (not needed for Overlay mode)
6. **CanvasDebugHelper**: Still active - will add red background
7. **FaceDetector logging**: Enhanced to report Canvas render mode

### **What You Should See Now:**

1. **🔴 BRIGHT RED BACKGROUND** covering your entire view
2. **Camera feed** showing what Camera 2 sees
3. **Thick multi-colored bounding boxes** around detected faces

The red background will be VERY obvious - it will cover your whole field of view in the headset.

### **What the Logs Will Say:**

Look for:
```
✅✅✅ Canvas is set to SCREEN SPACE OVERLAY - This should render to AR headset! ✅✅✅
🔴🔴🔴 CanvasDebugHelper: Added BRIGHT RED background to Canvas 🔴🔴🔴
ℹ️ FollowCamera script is attached but DISABLED (OK for ScreenSpaceOverlay mode)
```

---

**Build and deploy this version** - I'm very confident this will work! Screen Space - Overlay is the standard way to display UI in XR/AR headsets, and it should render directly to your Magic Leap 2's displays. The fact that you weren't even seeing the red background with World Space mode confirms this was the issue.

**Cursor**

I can see the issue now! Looking at your description and the logs, the problem is that your `RawImage` is set to black and covering the entire screen. This is exactly what's blocking everything else from being visible.

Let me search for how others handle OpenCV UI overlays on Magic Leap 2 to find the best practices:



Perfect! I found the exact issue. Based on the research, here's what's happening:

## The Problem: Black Canvas = Invisible on Magic Leap 2

The Magic Leap 2 uses **additive color mixing** where **black = transparent/no light**. When you set your `RawImage` to black, it becomes completely invisible on the Magic Leap 2 display, which is exactly what you're experiencing!

## The Solution

Let me fix this by making the `RawImage` transparent instead of black, so you can see the camera feed and the face detection boxes:


Let me search for the RawImage component in the scene file:


Let me find the RawImage component:


Let me find the RawImage component specifically:


Perfect! I found the issue. The `RawImage` has `m_Color: {r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 1}` which means it's set to **black with full opacity**. This is exactly what's blocking everything!

Let me fix this by making the RawImage transparent so you can see the camera feed:

Perfect! I've fixed the main issue. The problem was that your `RawImage` was set to **black color** `{r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 1}`, which on Magic Leap 2's additive display system means **completely transparent/invisible**.

## What I Fixed:

1. **Changed RawImage color from black to white**: `{r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 1}` → `{r: 1, g: 1, b: 1, a: 1}`

This will now show the camera feed properly instead of a black screen!

## Why This Fixes It:

- **Magic Leap 2 uses additive color mixing** where black = no light = invisible
- **White color** `{r: 1, g: 1, b: 1, a: 1}` will display the camera texture normally
- **The camera feed will now be visible** with the face detection green boxes overlaid on top

## What You Should See Now:

1. **Camera feed** from your Magic Leap 2's RGB camera
2. **Green bounding boxes** around detected faces
3. **Red debug background** from the CanvasDebugHelper (if the Canvas is rendering)

## Next Steps:

1. **Build and deploy** the updated scene
2. **Look for the camera feed** - you should now see the actual camera image instead of black
3. **Look for green boxes** around faces when someone is in view

The face detection was working all along - you just couldn't see it because the RawImage was black! Now you should see both the camera feed and the face detection boxes.

Try building and running this version - you should finally see the camera feed and face detection working! 🎉

**User**

well now wont it just be a white box in my face? 

---

**Cursor**

You're absolutely right! A white box would be just as bad as a black box - it would block your entire view! 

The issue is that we need the `RawImage` to show the **camera feed texture**, not just a solid color. The color property in Unity UI components acts as a **tint** that multiplies with the texture. 

Let me check what's happening with the texture assignment in the FaceDetector script:


Let me find where the texture is assigned to the RawImage:


Perfect! I found it. The texture **is** being assigned correctly on line 187: `DisplayImage.texture = _displayTexture;`

The issue is that the `_displayTexture` gets updated in the `Update()` method with the camera feed and face detection boxes. But you're right - we need to make sure the RawImage color doesn't interfere.

Let me check what the ideal color should be. For Unity UI RawImage:
- `{r: 1, g: 1, b: 1, a: 1}` = **white** = shows texture normally (multiplies by 1)
- `{r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 1}` = **black** = makes texture invisible (multiplies by 0)
- `{r: 0.5, g: 0.5, b: 0.5, a: 1}` = **gray** = dims texture (multiplies by 0.5)

Actually, **white `{r: 1, g: 1, b: 1, a: 1}` is correct** - it will show the camera texture normally without any tinting. The RawImage will display the camera feed texture, not a solid white box.

But let me double-check that the texture is actually being updated in the Update method:


Perfect! I can see the complete flow now:

1. **Line 187**: `DisplayImage.texture = _displayTexture;` - Texture is assigned to RawImage
2. **Line 334**: `MatToTexture();` - Updates the display texture with camera feed + face boxes
3. **Line 367**: `TextureConverter.MatToTexture(_rgbaMat, _displayTexture);` - Converts the OpenCV Mat (with camera feed + face boxes) to the display texture

So the **white color `{r: 1, g: 1, b: 1, a: 1}` is correct**! It will show:
- The **camera feed** from your Magic Leap 2
- **Green/red/yellow bounding boxes** around detected faces
- **NOT a solid white box**

The color property in Unity UI acts as a **multiplier/tint**:
- `{r: 1, g: 1, b: 1, a: 1}` = **no tinting** = shows texture normally
- `{r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 1}` = **black tint** = makes texture invisible

## What You'll See:

1. **Your camera feed** (the actual view from Magic Leap 2's RGB camera)
2. **Green bounding boxes** around any detected faces
3. **Red debug background** from the CanvasDebugHelper (if Canvas is rendering)

The RawImage will display the camera texture, not a solid color. The white color just ensures the texture displays at full brightness without any tinting.

**Build and test this version** - you should now see the camera feed with face detection boxes! 🎉

**Cursor**

I can see the issue now! That warning is the key:

> "A Canvas named "Canvas" with a render mode of ScreenSpaceOverlay is being used while VR is also enabled. This Canvas will continue to incur a rendering cost, but will not be visible while in VR. Is this intentional?"

The problem is that Magic Leap 2 is running in VR mode, and Unity's `ScreenSpaceOverlay` Canvas is **not visible in VR mode**. This explains why you're not seeing anything despite face detection working perfectly.

Let me research the correct approach for Magic Leap 2 UI rendering and then fix this:



Perfect! Now I understand the issue. The warning message is clear: **"ScreenSpaceOverlay Canvas will not be visible while in VR"**. 

For Magic Leap 2, we need to use **World Space** Canvas mode, but we need to configure it properly. Let me fix this by switching back to World Space and ensuring the Canvas is positioned correctly in front of the camera.

Perfect! Now let me update the FaceDetector script to provide better logging about the Canvas configuration:


```csharp

using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using OpenCvSharp;
using OpenCvSharp.Unity;
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.IO;
using UnityEngine.Networking;

public class FaceDetector : MonoBehaviour
{
    // Unity will auto-load native libraries from Assets/Plugins/Android/libs/x86_64/
    
    public RawImage DisplayImage;
    public float DetectionBoxScale = 2.0f;
    public int DownsampleFactor = 2;  // Changed from 4 to 2 for better detection

    private WebCamTexture _webCamTexture;
    private CascadeClassifier _cascade;
    private Mat _rgbaMat;
    private Mat _grayMat;
    private Texture2D _displayTexture;
    private bool _isInitialized = false;

    private const string CameraPermission = "android.permission.CAMERA";

    void Start()
    {
        Debug.Log($"FaceDetector starting - DisplayImage assigned: {DisplayImage != null}");
        StartCoroutine(CheckAndRequestPermissions());
    }

    private IEnumerator CheckAndRequestPermissions()
    {
        Debug.Log("Checking for camera permission...");

        if (UnityEngine.Android.Permission.HasUserAuthorizedPermission(CameraPermission))
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission already granted.");
            yield return StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission not yet granted. Requesting...");
            var callbacks = new UnityEngine.Android.PermissionCallbacks();
            callbacks.PermissionGranted += OnPermissionGranted;
            callbacks.PermissionDenied += OnPermissionDenied;
            callbacks.PermissionDeniedAndDontAskAgain += OnPermissionDenied;
            UnityEngine.Android.Permission.RequestUserPermission(CameraPermission, callbacks);
        }
    }

    private void OnPermissionGranted(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.Log($"Permission {permissionName} was granted. Proceeding with initialization.");
        StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
    }

    private void OnPermissionDenied(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.LogError($"Permission {permissionName} was denied. Face detection cannot start.");
    }

    private IEnumerator InitializeEverything()
    {
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZING WEBCAM ===");
        
        // Add timeout protection
        float timeout = 30f; // 30 seconds timeout
        float startTime = Time.time;
        
        // Get available cameras
        WebCamDevice[] devices = WebCamTexture.devices;
        Debug.Log($"Found {devices.Length} camera devices");
        
        if (devices.Length == 0)
        {
            Debug.LogError("ERROR: No cameras found on device!");
            yield break;
        }

        // Log available cameras
        for (int i = 0; i < devices.Length; i++)
        {
            Debug.Log($"Camera {i}: {devices[i].name} (Front: {devices[i].isFrontFacing})");
        }

        // Try Camera 2 instead - Camera 0 was completely black (tracking sensor, not RGB camera)
        // Magic Leap 2 has: 2 tracking sensors + 1 RGB camera on top
        int cameraIndex = 2;  // Try camera 2 (top RGB camera)
        Debug.Log($"🎥 Attempting to use Camera {cameraIndex}: {devices[cameraIndex].name}");
        _webCamTexture = new WebCamTexture(devices[cameraIndex].name, 1280, 720, 30);
        _webCamTexture.Play();

        Debug.Log($"Started camera: {devices[cameraIndex].name}, waiting for first frame...");
        int waitFrames = 0;
        while (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            waitFrames++;
            if (waitFrames > 300) // 10 seconds at 30fps
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Camera timeout! Camera playing: {_webCamTexture.isPlaying}, Size: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height}");
                yield break;
            }
            yield return null;
        }

        Debug.Log($"=== CAMERA STARTED: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height} @ {_webCamTexture.requestedFPS}fps ===");

        Debug.Log("OpenCV libraries should be auto-loaded by Unity from Plugins folder...");
        
        // Check timeout
        if (Time.time - startTime > timeout)
        {
            Debug.LogError("TIMEOUT: Initialization took too long!");
            yield break;
        }
        
        // Add a small delay to let Unity load the libraries
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
        
        try
        {
            Debug.Log("Testing OpenCV initialization...");
            // Try a simple OpenCV operation to test if libraries loaded
            using (var testMat = new Mat(1, 1, MatType.CV_8UC1))
            {
                Debug.Log($"OpenCV test Mat created successfully! Size: {testMat.Width}x{testMat.Height}");
            }
            Debug.Log("OpenCV library loaded successfully!");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR: OpenCV failed to initialize! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
            yield break;
        }
        
        Debug.Log("Loading Haar Cascade classifier...");
        string cascadePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
        
        using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(cascadePath))
        {
            yield return www.SendWebRequest();
            if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Failed to load haarcascade file: {www.error}");
                yield break;
            }
            
            string tempPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
            File.WriteAllBytes(tempPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
            Debug.Log($"Wrote cascade to: {tempPath}");
            
            try
            {
                Debug.Log($"Creating CascadeClassifier from: {tempPath}");
                _cascade = new CascadeClassifier(tempPath);
                Debug.Log("CascadeClassifier object created");
                
                if (_cascade.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogError("ERROR: Cascade classifier is empty!");
                    yield break;
                }
                Debug.Log("Cascade classifier loaded successfully!");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR creating CascadeClassifier! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
                Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
                if (ex.InnerException != null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"Inner exception: {ex.InnerException.GetType().Name}: {ex.InnerException.Message}");
                }
                yield break;
            }
        }

        Debug.Log($"Creating Mats and display texture ({_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height})...");
        _grayMat = new Mat(_webCamTexture.height, _webCamTexture.width, MatType.CV_8UC1);
        _displayTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false);
        
        if (DisplayImage != null)
        {
            DisplayImage.texture = _displayTexture;
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Display texture assigned to RawImage - you'll see the camera feed with face boxes! ✅✅✅");
            Debug.Log($"📱 RawImage size: {DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.width}x{DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.height}");
            
            // Get Canvas info
            var canvas = DisplayImage.GetComponentInParent<Canvas>();
            if (canvas != null)
            {
                Debug.Log($"🖼️ Canvas found! Name: '{canvas.gameObject.name}', Position: {canvas.transform.position}, Scale: {canvas.transform.localScale}");
                Debug.Log($"🎨 Canvas Render Mode: {canvas.renderMode} (0=ScreenSpaceOverlay, 1=ScreenSpaceCamera, 2=WorldSpace)");
                
                if (canvas.renderMode == RenderMode.ScreenSpaceOverlay)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️⚠️⚠️ Canvas is SCREEN SPACE OVERLAY - This will NOT be visible in VR mode! ⚠️⚠️⚠️");
                }
                else if (canvas.renderMode == RenderMode.WorldSpace)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Canvas is WORLD SPACE - This should render in VR/AR! ✅✅✅");
                }
                else if (canvas.renderMode == RenderMode.ScreenSpaceCamera)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Canvas is SCREEN SPACE CAMERA - This should render in VR/AR! ✅✅✅");
                }
                
                // Check if FollowCamera is attached
                var followCam = canvas.GetComponent<FollowCamera>();
                if (followCam != null)
                {
                    if (followCam.enabled)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"✅ FollowCamera script IS attached and ENABLED on Canvas!");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"ℹ️ FollowCamera script is attached but DISABLED (OK for ScreenSpaceOverlay mode)");
                    }
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ No Canvas parent found for RawImage!");
            }
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ WARNING: No RawImage found for display. Face detection is running but won't be visible.");
        }

        _isInitialized = true;
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZATION COMPLETE! Face detection should now be running. ===");
    }

    private int _frameCount = 0;
    private int _totalFacesDetected = 0;
    private bool _savedDebugFrames = false;
    
    void Update()
    {
        if (!_isInitialized || _webCamTexture == null || !_webCamTexture.isPlaying)
        {
            // Log why we're not processing (only every 60 frames to avoid spam)
            if (Time.frameCount % 60 == 0)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"Not processing: _isInitialized={_isInitialized}, _webCamTexture={_webCamTexture != null}, isPlaying={_webCamTexture?.isPlaying}");
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            return;
        }

        _frameCount++;
        
        // Log that we're actually processing
        if (_frameCount == 1)
        {
            Debug.Log("🎬 FIRST FRAME PROCESSING STARTED!");
        }
        
        try
        {
            TextureToMat();
            
            // Debug logging for first few frames
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: GrayMat size {_grayMat.Width}x{_grayMat.Height}, channels={_grayMat.Channels()}");
            }
            
            // Save debug frames (first 3 frames only)
            if (!_savedDebugFrames && _frameCount <= 3)
            {
                SaveDebugFrame(_frameCount);
                if (_frameCount == 3)
                {
                    _savedDebugFrames = true;
                    Debug.Log("✅ Debug frames saved! Use 'adb pull' to retrieve them from device.");
                }
            }
            
            // Downsample for performance
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            
            // Apply histogram equalization to improve contrast - VERY important for face detection!
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: SmallMat size {smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} for detection (with histogram equalization)");
            }

            // MUCH more relaxed detection parameters to test
            OpenCvSharp.Rect[] faces = _cascade.DetectMultiScale(
                image: smallMat,
                scaleFactor: 1.05,      // Smaller scale factor = more sensitive
                minNeighbors: 2,        // Even fewer neighbors = more detections (was 3)
                flags: HaarDetectionTypes.ScaleImage,
                minSize: new Size(15, 15)  // Smaller minimum size (was 20x20)
            );

            // Log detection results more frequently at first
            if (_frameCount <= 10 || (_frameCount % 30 == 0))
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: Detected {faces.Length} faces");
            }

            if (faces.Length > 0)
            {
                _totalFacesDetected += faces.Length;
                Debug.Log($"🟢 FACE DETECTED! Frame {_frameCount}: {faces.Length} face(s) - Drawing green boxes now!");
            }

            foreach (var face in faces)
            {
                var scaledRect = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(
                    face.X * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Y * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Width * DownsampleFactor,
                    face.Height * DownsampleFactor
                );
                
                // Draw MULTIPLE THICK colored rectangles for maximum visibility!
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.Red, 15);        // Outer red border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.LimeGreen, 12);  // Green border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.Yellow, 8);      // Yellow inner border
                Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.White, 4);       // White innermost border
            }

            MatToTexture();
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            // Log status every 5 seconds
            if (_frameCount % 150 == 0)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Status - Frame: {_frameCount}, Total faces found: {_totalFacesDetected}, Current faces: {faces.Length}");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"ERROR in Update: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    private void TextureToMat()
    {
        // Dispose the Mat from the previous frame to prevent a memory leak
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        
        // Convert WebCamTexture to Texture2D-compatible format
        Texture2D tempTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGB24, false);
        tempTexture.SetPixels32(_webCamTexture.GetPixels32());
        tempTexture.Apply();
        
        _rgbaMat = TextureConverter.TextureToMat(tempTexture);
        Destroy(tempTexture);
        
        Cv2.CvtColor(_rgbaMat, _grayMat, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
    }

    private void MatToTexture()
    {
        TextureConverter.MatToTexture(_rgbaMat, _displayTexture);
    }
    
    private void SaveDebugFrame(int frameNum)
    {
        try
        {
            // Use app's external files directory - no extra permissions needed!
            // This is at: /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.DefaultCompany.MagicLeap_Recogneyes/files/
            string saveDir = Application.persistentDataPath;
            
            Debug.Log($"💾 Saving debug frame {frameNum} to: {saveDir}");
            
            // Save original color frame
            string colorPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_original.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(colorPath, _rgbaMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved ORIGINAL (1280x720 color) → {colorPath}");
            
            // Save grayscale frame
            string grayPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_grayscale.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(grayPath, _grayMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved GRAYSCALE (1280x720) → {grayPath}");
            
            // Save downsampled frame (what the detector actually analyzes)
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            string smallPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_detection.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(smallPath, smallMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved DETECTION ({smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} with histogram eq) → {smallPath}");
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Frame {frameNum} SAVED SUCCESSFULLY! ✅✅✅");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to save debug frame: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    void OnDestroy()
    {
        if (_webCamTexture != null)
        {
            _webCamTexture.Stop();
        }
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        _grayMat?.Dispose();
    }
}

namespace OpenCvSharp.Unity
{
    public static class TextureConverter
    {
        public static Mat TextureToMat(Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = texture.width;
            int height = texture.height;
            Color32[] colors = texture.GetPixels32();
            Mat mat = new Mat(height, width, MatType.CV_8UC4);

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Color32 color = colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x];
                    var vec = new Vec4b(color.b, color.g, color.r, color.a);
                    mat.Set(y, x, vec);
                }
            }
            return mat;
        }

        public static void MatToTexture(Mat mat, Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = mat.Cols;
            int height = mat.Rows;
            Color32[] colors = new Color32[width * height];

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Vec4b color = mat.Get<Vec4b>(y, x);
                    colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x] = new Color32(color.Item2, color.Item1, color.Item0, color.Item3);
                }
            }
            
            texture.SetPixels32(colors);
            texture.Apply();
        }
    }
}

```

Perfect! I found and fixed the issue! 🎯

## The Problem
The warning message was the key: **"A Canvas named "Canvas" with a render mode of ScreenSpaceOverlay is being used while VR is also enabled. This Canvas will continue to incur a rendering cost, but will not be visible while in VR."**

Magic Leap 2 runs in **VR mode**, and Unity's `ScreenSpaceOverlay` Canvas is **completely invisible in VR mode**. That's why you weren't seeing anything despite face detection working perfectly!

## The Solution
I've switched the Canvas back to **World Space** mode (`m_RenderMode: 2`) and configured it properly:

1. **Canvas Render Mode**: Changed from `ScreenSpaceOverlay (0)` to `WorldSpace (2)`
2. **Canvas Position**: Set to `(0, 0, 1)` - 1 meter in front of the camera
3. **Canvas Scale**: Set to `(0.01, 0.01, 0.01)` - appropriately sized for AR viewing
4. **FollowCamera**: Re-enabled on the Canvas to keep it positioned in front of your head
5. **Updated Logging**: The script now correctly identifies World Space as the right mode for VR/AR

## Why This Will Work
- **World Space Canvas** renders as a 3D object in the scene, which is visible in VR mode
- **FollowCamera script** keeps the UI positioned 0.5 meters in front of your head
- **Red debug background** will make the Canvas impossible to miss if it's rendering
- **White RawImage** will show the camera feed and green bounding boxes

## Next Steps
Build and deploy this updated version. You should now see:
1. The bright red debug background (confirming the Canvas is rendering)
2. The camera feed with green face detection boxes
3. The UI following your head movement

The face detection is already working perfectly - this was purely a UI rendering issue in VR mode! 🚀

**Cursor**

🎉 **YES! IT'S WORKING!** 🎉

That's **exactly** what it's supposed to do! Let me explain what you're seeing:

## What's Happening Now ✅

1. **White Box (Camera Feed)**: The white flashing box is the **live camera feed** from the Magic Leap 2's RGB camera displaying on your Canvas!

2. **Red Box (Face Detection)**: When you look at your buddy and it turns **red**, that's the **face detection bounding box**! The code is drawing multiple colored rectangles (red, green, yellow, white) around detected faces, and you're seeing the outer red border.

## Why Red and Not Green? 🤔

Looking at the code in `FaceDetector.cs` (lines 327-330):
```csharp
// Draw MULTIPLE THICK colored rectangles for maximum visibility!
Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.Red, 15);        // Outer red border
Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.LimeGreen, 12);  // Green border
Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.Yellow, 8);      // Yellow inner border
Cv2.Rectangle(_rgbaMat, scaledRect, Scalar.White, 4);       // White innermost border
```

The **red** is the outermost, thickest border (15 pixels), so it's the most visible! The green, yellow, and white borders are inside it, but they might be harder to see on the Magic Leap 2's display.

## Success Confirmation 🚀

Your logs show:
- ✅ **Face detection working**: "🟢 FACE DETECTED! Frame X: Y face(s)"
- ✅ **Canvas rendering in VR**: World Space mode working
- ✅ **FollowCamera working**: Canvas following your head
- ✅ **Visual feedback visible**: You're seeing the bounding boxes!

Now let me update the code to create a clean AR experience - transparent background with just hollow face borders:

```csharp

using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using OpenCvSharp;
using OpenCvSharp.Unity;
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.IO;
using UnityEngine.Networking;

public class FaceDetector : MonoBehaviour
{
    // Unity will auto-load native libraries from Assets/Plugins/Android/libs/x86_64/
    
    public RawImage DisplayImage;
    public float DetectionBoxScale = 2.0f;
    public int DownsampleFactor = 2;  // Changed from 4 to 2 for better detection

    private WebCamTexture _webCamTexture;
    private CascadeClassifier _cascade;
    private Mat _rgbaMat;
    private Mat _grayMat;
    private Texture2D _displayTexture;
    private bool _isInitialized = false;

    private const string CameraPermission = "android.permission.CAMERA";

    void Start()
    {
        Debug.Log($"FaceDetector starting - DisplayImage assigned: {DisplayImage != null}");
        StartCoroutine(CheckAndRequestPermissions());
    }

    private IEnumerator CheckAndRequestPermissions()
    {
        Debug.Log("Checking for camera permission...");

        if (UnityEngine.Android.Permission.HasUserAuthorizedPermission(CameraPermission))
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission already granted.");
            yield return StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.Log("Camera permission not yet granted. Requesting...");
            var callbacks = new UnityEngine.Android.PermissionCallbacks();
            callbacks.PermissionGranted += OnPermissionGranted;
            callbacks.PermissionDenied += OnPermissionDenied;
            callbacks.PermissionDeniedAndDontAskAgain += OnPermissionDenied;
            UnityEngine.Android.Permission.RequestUserPermission(CameraPermission, callbacks);
        }
    }

    private void OnPermissionGranted(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.Log($"Permission {permissionName} was granted. Proceeding with initialization.");
        StartCoroutine(InitializeEverything());
    }

    private void OnPermissionDenied(string permissionName)
    {
        Debug.LogError($"Permission {permissionName} was denied. Face detection cannot start.");
    }

    private IEnumerator InitializeEverything()
    {
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZING WEBCAM ===");
        
        // Add timeout protection
        float timeout = 30f; // 30 seconds timeout
        float startTime = Time.time;
        
        // Get available cameras
        WebCamDevice[] devices = WebCamTexture.devices;
        Debug.Log($"Found {devices.Length} camera devices");
        
        if (devices.Length == 0)
        {
            Debug.LogError("ERROR: No cameras found on device!");
            yield break;
        }

        // Log available cameras
        for (int i = 0; i < devices.Length; i++)
        {
            Debug.Log($"Camera {i}: {devices[i].name} (Front: {devices[i].isFrontFacing})");
        }

        // Try Camera 2 instead - Camera 0 was completely black (tracking sensor, not RGB camera)
        // Magic Leap 2 has: 2 tracking sensors + 1 RGB camera on top
        int cameraIndex = 2;  // Try camera 2 (top RGB camera)
        Debug.Log($"🎥 Attempting to use Camera {cameraIndex}: {devices[cameraIndex].name}");
        _webCamTexture = new WebCamTexture(devices[cameraIndex].name, 1280, 720, 30);
        _webCamTexture.Play();

        Debug.Log($"Started camera: {devices[cameraIndex].name}, waiting for first frame...");
        int waitFrames = 0;
        while (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            waitFrames++;
            if (waitFrames > 300) // 10 seconds at 30fps
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Camera timeout! Camera playing: {_webCamTexture.isPlaying}, Size: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height}");
                yield break;
            }
            yield return null;
        }

        Debug.Log($"=== CAMERA STARTED: {_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height} @ {_webCamTexture.requestedFPS}fps ===");

        Debug.Log("OpenCV libraries should be auto-loaded by Unity from Plugins folder...");
        
        // Check timeout
        if (Time.time - startTime > timeout)
        {
            Debug.LogError("TIMEOUT: Initialization took too long!");
            yield break;
        }
        
        // Add a small delay to let Unity load the libraries
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
        
        try
        {
            Debug.Log("Testing OpenCV initialization...");
            // Try a simple OpenCV operation to test if libraries loaded
            using (var testMat = new Mat(1, 1, MatType.CV_8UC1))
            {
                Debug.Log($"OpenCV test Mat created successfully! Size: {testMat.Width}x{testMat.Height}");
            }
            Debug.Log("OpenCV library loaded successfully!");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR: OpenCV failed to initialize! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
            yield break;
        }
        
        Debug.Log("Loading Haar Cascade classifier...");
        string cascadePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
        
        using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(cascadePath))
        {
            yield return www.SendWebRequest();
            if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"ERROR: Failed to load haarcascade file: {www.error}");
                yield break;
            }
            
            string tempPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml");
            File.WriteAllBytes(tempPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
            Debug.Log($"Wrote cascade to: {tempPath}");
            
            try
            {
                Debug.Log($"Creating CascadeClassifier from: {tempPath}");
                _cascade = new CascadeClassifier(tempPath);
                Debug.Log("CascadeClassifier object created");
                
                if (_cascade.Empty())
                {
                    Debug.LogError("ERROR: Cascade classifier is empty!");
                    yield break;
                }
                Debug.Log("Cascade classifier loaded successfully!");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"CRITICAL ERROR creating CascadeClassifier! {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
                Debug.LogError($"Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
                if (ex.InnerException != null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"Inner exception: {ex.InnerException.GetType().Name}: {ex.InnerException.Message}");
                }
                yield break;
            }
        }

        Debug.Log($"Creating Mats and display texture ({_webCamTexture.width}x{_webCamTexture.height})...");
        _grayMat = new Mat(_webCamTexture.height, _webCamTexture.width, MatType.CV_8UC1);
        _displayTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false);
        
        if (DisplayImage != null)
        {
            DisplayImage.texture = _displayTexture;
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Display texture assigned to RawImage - you'll see the camera feed with face boxes! ✅✅✅");
            Debug.Log($"📱 RawImage size: {DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.width}x{DisplayImage.rectTransform.rect.height}");
            
            // Get Canvas info
            var canvas = DisplayImage.GetComponentInParent<Canvas>();
            if (canvas != null)
            {
                Debug.Log($"🖼️ Canvas found! Name: '{canvas.gameObject.name}', Position: {canvas.transform.position}, Scale: {canvas.transform.localScale}");
                Debug.Log($"🎨 Canvas Render Mode: {canvas.renderMode} (0=ScreenSpaceOverlay, 1=ScreenSpaceCamera, 2=WorldSpace)");
                
                if (canvas.renderMode == RenderMode.ScreenSpaceOverlay)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"⚠️⚠️⚠️ Canvas is SCREEN SPACE OVERLAY - This will NOT be visible in VR mode! ⚠️⚠️⚠️");
                }
                else if (canvas.renderMode == RenderMode.WorldSpace)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Canvas is WORLD SPACE - This should render in VR/AR! ✅✅✅");
                }
                else if (canvas.renderMode == RenderMode.ScreenSpaceCamera)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Canvas is SCREEN SPACE CAMERA - This should render in VR/AR! ✅✅✅");
                }
                
                // Check if FollowCamera is attached
                var followCam = canvas.GetComponent<FollowCamera>();
                if (followCam != null)
                {
                    if (followCam.enabled)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"✅ FollowCamera script IS attached and ENABLED on Canvas!");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"ℹ️ FollowCamera script is attached but DISABLED (OK for ScreenSpaceOverlay mode)");
                    }
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ No Canvas parent found for RawImage!");
            }
        }
        else
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ WARNING: No RawImage found for display. Face detection is running but won't be visible.");
        }

        _isInitialized = true;
        Debug.Log("=== INITIALIZATION COMPLETE! Face detection should now be running. ===");
    }

    private int _frameCount = 0;
    private int _totalFacesDetected = 0;
    private bool _savedDebugFrames = false;
    
    void Update()
    {
        if (!_isInitialized || _webCamTexture == null || !_webCamTexture.isPlaying)
        {
            // Log why we're not processing (only every 60 frames to avoid spam)
            if (Time.frameCount % 60 == 0)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"Not processing: _isInitialized={_isInitialized}, _webCamTexture={_webCamTexture != null}, isPlaying={_webCamTexture?.isPlaying}");
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!_webCamTexture.didUpdateThisFrame)
        {
            return;
        }

        _frameCount++;
        
        // Log that we're actually processing
        if (_frameCount == 1)
        {
            Debug.Log("🎬 FIRST FRAME PROCESSING STARTED!");
        }
        
        try
        {
            TextureToMat();
            
            // Debug logging for first few frames
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: GrayMat size {_grayMat.Width}x{_grayMat.Height}, channels={_grayMat.Channels()}");
            }
            
            // Save debug frames (first 3 frames only)
            if (!_savedDebugFrames && _frameCount <= 3)
            {
                SaveDebugFrame(_frameCount);
                if (_frameCount == 3)
                {
                    _savedDebugFrames = true;
                    Debug.Log("✅ Debug frames saved! Use 'adb pull' to retrieve them from device.");
                }
            }
            
            // Downsample for performance
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            
            // Apply histogram equalization to improve contrast - VERY important for face detection!
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            
            if (_frameCount <= 3)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: SmallMat size {smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} for detection (with histogram equalization)");
            }

            // MUCH more relaxed detection parameters to test
            OpenCvSharp.Rect[] faces = _cascade.DetectMultiScale(
                image: smallMat,
                scaleFactor: 1.05,      // Smaller scale factor = more sensitive
                minNeighbors: 2,        // Even fewer neighbors = more detections (was 3)
                flags: HaarDetectionTypes.ScaleImage,
                minSize: new Size(15, 15)  // Smaller minimum size (was 20x20)
            );

            // Log detection results more frequently at first
            if (_frameCount <= 10 || (_frameCount % 30 == 0))
            {
                Debug.Log($"Frame {_frameCount}: Detected {faces.Length} faces");
            }

            if (faces.Length > 0)
            {
                _totalFacesDetected += faces.Length;
                Debug.Log($"🟢 FACE DETECTED! Frame {_frameCount}: {faces.Length} face(s) - Drawing green boxes now!");
            }

            // CLEAN AR MODE: Only show hollow borders when faces detected, otherwise transparent
            if (faces.Length > 0)
            {
                // Create transparent Mat to draw ONLY the face borders
                var borderMat = new Mat(_rgbaMat.Size(), MatType.CV_8UC4, new Scalar(0, 0, 0, 0)); // Fully transparent
                
                foreach (var face in faces)
                {
                    var scaledRect = new OpenCvSharp.Rect(
                        face.X * DownsampleFactor,
                        face.Y * DownsampleFactor,
                        face.Width * DownsampleFactor,
                        face.Height * DownsampleFactor
                    );
                    
                    // Draw a clean, bright HOLLOW border (green for visibility in AR)
                    // Thickness of 8 gives a nice visible hollow border
                    Cv2.Rectangle(borderMat, scaledRect, new Scalar(0, 255, 0, 255), 8);  // Bright green, fully opaque
                }
                
                // Use the border mat instead of camera feed
                _rgbaMat.Dispose();
                _rgbaMat = borderMat;
            }
            else
            {
                // NO FACES: Make completely transparent
                _rgbaMat.SetTo(new Scalar(0, 0, 0, 0));
            }

            MatToTexture();
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            // Log status every 5 seconds
            if (_frameCount % 150 == 0)
            {
                Debug.Log($"Status - Frame: {_frameCount}, Total faces found: {_totalFacesDetected}, Current faces: {faces.Length}");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"ERROR in Update: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    private void TextureToMat()
    {
        // Dispose the Mat from the previous frame to prevent a memory leak
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        
        // Convert WebCamTexture to Texture2D-compatible format
        Texture2D tempTexture = new Texture2D(_webCamTexture.width, _webCamTexture.height, TextureFormat.RGB24, false);
        tempTexture.SetPixels32(_webCamTexture.GetPixels32());
        tempTexture.Apply();
        
        _rgbaMat = TextureConverter.TextureToMat(tempTexture);
        Destroy(tempTexture);
        
        Cv2.CvtColor(_rgbaMat, _grayMat, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
    }

    private void MatToTexture()
    {
        TextureConverter.MatToTexture(_rgbaMat, _displayTexture);
    }
    
    private void SaveDebugFrame(int frameNum)
    {
        try
        {
            // Use app's external files directory - no extra permissions needed!
            // This is at: /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.DefaultCompany.MagicLeap_Recogneyes/files/
            string saveDir = Application.persistentDataPath;
            
            Debug.Log($"💾 Saving debug frame {frameNum} to: {saveDir}");
            
            // Save original color frame
            string colorPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_original.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(colorPath, _rgbaMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved ORIGINAL (1280x720 color) → {colorPath}");
            
            // Save grayscale frame
            string grayPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_grayscale.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(grayPath, _grayMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved GRAYSCALE (1280x720) → {grayPath}");
            
            // Save downsampled frame (what the detector actually analyzes)
            var smallMat = new Mat();
            Cv2.Resize(_grayMat, smallMat, new Size(), 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, 1.0 / DownsampleFactor, InterpolationFlags.Linear);
            Cv2.EqualizeHist(smallMat, smallMat);
            string smallPath = Path.Combine(saveDir, $"frame_{frameNum}_detection.jpg");
            Cv2.ImWrite(smallPath, smallMat);
            Debug.Log($"📸 Saved DETECTION ({smallMat.Width}x{smallMat.Height} with histogram eq) → {smallPath}");
            smallMat.Dispose();
            
            Debug.Log($"✅✅✅ Frame {frameNum} SAVED SUCCESSFULLY! ✅✅✅");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to save debug frame: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
        }
    }
    
    void OnDestroy()
    {
        if (_webCamTexture != null)
        {
            _webCamTexture.Stop();
        }
        _rgbaMat?.Dispose();
        _grayMat?.Dispose();
    }
}

namespace OpenCvSharp.Unity
{
    public static class TextureConverter
    {
        public static Mat TextureToMat(Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = texture.width;
            int height = texture.height;
            Color32[] colors = texture.GetPixels32();
            Mat mat = new Mat(height, width, MatType.CV_8UC4);

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Color32 color = colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x];
                    var vec = new Vec4b(color.b, color.g, color.r, color.a);
                    mat.Set(y, x, vec);
                }
            }
            return mat;
        }

        public static void MatToTexture(Mat mat, Texture2D texture)
        {
            int width = mat.Cols;
            int height = mat.Rows;
            Color32[] colors = new Color32[width * height];

            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
                {
                    Vec4b color = mat.Get<Vec4b>(y, x);
                    colors[(height - 1 - y) * width + x] = new Color32(color.Item2, color.Item1, color.Item0, color.Item3);
                }
            }
            
            texture.SetPixels32(colors);
            texture.Apply();
        }
    }
}
```

Perfect! I've made the changes for a **clean AR experience**. Here's what I did:

## Changes Made ✅

### 1. **Transparent Background** 
- When **no faces detected**: The display is **completely transparent** (invisible)
- You won't see anything - no white box, no camera feed - completely clear AR view

### 2. **Hollow Border Only**
- When **faces detected**: Only shows a **bright green hollow border** (just the outline, thickness of 8 pixels)
- No filled boxes, no camera feed background - just a clean border around the face
- Used bright green (`Scalar(0, 255, 0, 255)`) for good visibility in AR

### 3. **Removed Debug Background**
- Deleted the `CanvasDebugHelper` script that was creating the red background
- Canvas is now completely transparent when no faces are present

## How It Works Now 🎯

1. **Looking at nothing**: **Invisible** - you see the real world through Magic Leap 2
2. **Looking at your buddy**: A **green hollow box** appears around their face
3. **Look away**: Box **disappears** - back to clear AR view

## Next Steps

Build and deploy this updated version. You should now have a **much more comfortable AR experience** - no bright backgrounds hurting your eyes, just clean face detection borders when you need them!

The green color should be very visible on Magic Leap 2's additive display. If you want a different color or thicker/thinner border, let me know! 🚀
